comparison.objective: Remove a spring clothes peg from a basket and clip a hanging photo corner to a wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain spring-clip actuation during transport and align jaws around two thin targets, not apply coupled rotational torques.
comparison.success_condition: Second peg closed around both wire and photo, released and still, without dislodging the photo; all four versions were considered.
comparison.reason: This tests spring-clip transfer and thin-object capture.
